caustica.options.rt.title: Ray Tracing Settings
caustica.options.sharc.title: SHaRC Settings
caustica.options.sharc.enabled.tooltip: Caches bounced light so later bounces can reuse it: less noise, and usually faster.
caustica.options.sharc.cellSize.tooltip: Size of each cache cell, in blocks. Smaller is more accurate but settles slower; larger settles faster but blurs light.
caustica.options.sharc.cacheEntries.tool: Cache size. Larger covers more of the world but uses more video memory.
caustica.options.sharc.updateCoverage.to: How much of the cache is refreshed each frame. Higher reacts faster to lighting changes but costs more.
caustica.options.sharc.temporalBlend.too: Higher reacts faster to lighting changes but can flicker; lower is smoother but slower.
caustica.options.sharc.startBounce.toolt: First bounce that uses the cache. Lower is quieter but less accurate; higher is more accurate but noisier.
caustica.options.sharc.strength.tooltip: How much of the cached light is used. Lower darkens bounced light a little but softens cache edges.
caustica.options.sharc.frameLifetime.too: How long cached light is kept. Longer is smoother but can leave old light behind after big lighting changes.
caustica.options.sharc.normalThreshold.t: How closely surfaces must face the same way to share cached light. Lower shares more but is less accurate.
caustica.options.sharc.stableFrames.tool: Raise this if new cache cells pop in as a bright flash when the camera moves.
caustica.options.sharc.debug.tooltip: Logs a periodic SHaRC summary to the console. For debugging.
caustica.options.sharc.reset.tooltip: Clears the cache so it rebuilds from scratch. Use it if lighting looks stale.
caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: Auto adapts brightness to the scene; Manual uses a fixed exposure.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Brightness, in stops. Fixed in Manual; in Auto, makes everything brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: How many times light can bounce. Higher gives more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.earlyRoulette.toolti: Ends some light paths early at 4 or more bounces. About 20% faster; caves and rooms get slightly noisier.
caustica.options.rt.simpleRoughReflectio: Uses a cheaper sky, clouds and fog in blurry reflections. Saves a lot and is hard to see.
caustica.options.rt.skyCache.tooltip: Computes the sky seen by bounced light once per frame. Faster; bounced skylight may lose a little cloud detail.
caustica.options.rt.sunSize.tooltip: Size of the sun and moon. Larger gives softer shadows.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draws particles inside the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.weatherParticles.too: Draws rain and snow inside the ray-traced scene. Requires Ray-Traced Particles.
caustica.options.rt.omm.tooltip: Speeds up leaves, grass and other cutout blocks. Turn it off if you see glitches or crashes around them.
caustica.options.rt.rainDensity.tooltip: How heavy rain and snow look. 0% hides them; the sky still follows the weather.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Makes water move in real waves instead of a scrolling texture.
caustica.options.rt.waterOpacity.tooltip: How much light passes through water. Raise it if DLSS draws a halo around water in the dark.
caustica.options.rt.sss.tooltip: Lets light shine through leaves and grass, so plants glow against the sun. Slight cost.
caustica.options.rt.weatherLighting.tool: Dims the sun and darkens the sky in rain and storms. Off keeps clear-sky light.
caustica.options.rt.clouds.tooltip: Draws clouds in the ray-traced sky, with their reflections and shadows.
caustica.options.rt.cloudStyle.tooltip: Classic: flat, blocky clouds like vanilla. Volumetric: real 3D clouds, much better looking but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.skyStyle.tooltip: Choose between the improved vivid pastel sky and the original vanilla-like sky.
caustica.options.rt.cloudHeight.tooltip: Height of the cloud base. Raise it if the clouds feel too close to the ground.
caustica.options.rt.cloudThickness.toolt: How tall classic clouds are. Thicker clouds cost more.
caustica.options.rt.cloudMinThickness.to: Thinnest volumetric cloud, in blocks. Set it equal to the maximum for clouds of one thickness.
caustica.options.rt.cloudMaxThickness.to: Thickest volumetric cloud, in blocks. A wider range gives a more natural mix.
caustica.options.rt.fastVolumetricClouds: Draws volumetric clouds with fewer samples. About 10% faster and looks almost the same.
Computes the clouds you look at in half resolution. A little faster; cloud edges may look softer.
How much clouds shade the ground. 0% casts no shadow; 100% can fully block the sun.
caustica.options.rt.cloudOpacity.tooltip: How solid clouds look. 0% hides them; lower is more see-through.
caustica.options.rt.denoiser.tooltip: Denoises the image with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Off shows the raw, grainy image. Requires DLSS.
caustica.options.rt.handFov.tooltip: Makes your hand follow the FOV setting. Off keeps vanilla's fixed hand FOV.
caustica.options.rt.viewmodelRayTraced.t: Draws your hand and held item inside the ray-traced scene, so held lights light the world. Costs a little.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Outputs HDR when your display supports it. Needs a game restart.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: How bright normal white looks on an HDR display, in nits.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Set this to your display's peak HDR brightness, in nits.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: Performance modes are faster; Quality and DLAA are sharper.
caustica.options.rt.dlssPreset.tooltip: Which DLSS Ray Reconstruction model to use. Auto lets the driver choose; F is the newest.
caustica.options.rt.upscaler.tooltip: How the image is upscaled. DLSS also denoises (NVIDIA RTX). FSR 3 and XeSS are experimental. Off renders at full resolution.
caustica.options.rt.fsrQuality.tooltip: Performance modes are faster; Quality modes are sharper.
caustica.options.rt.xessQuality.tooltip: Performance modes are faster; Quality modes are sharper.
caustica.options.rt.denoise.tooltip: Removes the noise from the ray-traced image. Turn it off only to see the raw image.
caustica.options.rt.nrd.tooltip: NVIDIA's denoiser: often cleaner reflections, but slower. Replaces the built-in denoiser; not with DLSS.
caustica.options.rt.nrdValidation.toolti: Shows NRD's debug overlay instead of the image. For debugging.
caustica.options.rt.frameGeneration.tool: Generates extra frames for smoother motion. Experimental. Needs DLSS and an RTX 40 or 50 series GPU.
caustica.options.rt.frameGeneration.unsu: Unavailable: DLSS Frame Generation needs an RTX 40 or 50 series GPU.
Generates extra frames with Caustica's own engine, on any GPU. Experimental; adds some GPU load and latency.
caustica.options.rt.fgMultiplier.tooltip: Frames shown per rendered frame. Higher is smoother but adds load and latency.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Visualize an intermediate ray-tracing buffer instead of the final image.
caustica.options.rt.blockEmissiveIntensi: Brightness of torches, lanterns, glowstone, lava and other glowing blocks.
caustica.options.rt.dynamicIntensity.too: Brightness of the light from glowing items in your hand.
caustica.options.rt.heldItemLight.toolti: Glowing items in your hand, like torches, light up the world around you.
caustica.options.rt.restirSampling.toolt: Reuses light samples across frames and pixels for less noise.
caustica.options.rt.tonemapOperator.tool: Selects the HDR-to-SDR tonemapping curve used after exposure.
caustica.options.rt.tonemapExposure.tool: Extra brightness on top of exposure, in stops.
caustica.options.rt.tonemapGamma.tooltip: Final gamma/look adjustment applied after the selected tonemap curve. 1.00 leaves the curve unchanged.
caustica.options.rt.tonemapSaturation.to: Final saturation multiplier applied after tonemapping. 1.00 is neutral; 0.00 is grayscale.
caustica.options.rt.tonemapContrast.tool: Final contrast multiplier around middle gray applied after tonemapping. 1.00 is neutral.
caustica.options.rt.parallax.tooltip: Adds 3D depth to textures from resource packs that support it.
caustica.options.rt.parallaxStrength.too: How deep the parallax relief looks.
caustica.options.rt.parallaxSmoothing.to: Smooth or crisp, pixel-sharp resource-pack surface detail.
caustica.options.rt.parallaxDistance.too: Distance, in blocks, at which parallax fades out.
caustica.options.voxy.enabled.tooltip: Enable Voxy distant terrain in the Caustica path tracer. This takes effect immediately.
caustica.options.voxy.ingest.tooltip: Allow Voxy to ingest and save newly loaded Minecraft chunks. Existing cached LODs remain available when disabled.
caustica.options.voxy.distance.tooltip: Maximum horizontal distance of Voxy terrain. Increasing it uses more memory and takes longer to populate.
caustica.options.rt.frameGeneration.nati: This GPU lacks DLSS Frame Generation, so Caustica's own engine is used (up to 4x). Adds some load and latency.
caustica.options.rt.reflex.tooltip: Lowers input latency, especially with Frame Generation. May slightly lower the maximum FPS.
caustica.options.rt.reflex.unsupported.t: Unavailable: needs a recent NVIDIA driver.
caustica.options.rt.metallicShininess.to: Makes metal surfaces shinier. 0% keeps the resource pack's look.
caustica.options.rt.resetToDefaults.tool: Resets the settings on this page only.
caustica.options.rt.resetAll: Reset All RT Settings to Defaults
caustica.options.rt.resetAll.tooltip: Resets every Caustica setting in these menus.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.tooltip: Picks settings for your GPU and screen, then measures about a minute of play, once, to choose the DLSS mode.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.measurin: Play normally for about a minute.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.doneNoDl: You can change them in Video Settings.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.estimate: Could not measure, so the estimate stays. Press the button again to retry.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.kept.mes: Kept the DLSS mode you picked.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.slow.mes: Your GPU is struggling, so it now uses %1$s.
caustica.options.rt.recommended.memory.m: Set Minecraft's memory to %1$s GB in your launcher.
caustica.options.rt.moonSize.tooltip: Size of the moon. Larger gives softer moonlight shadows.
caustica.options.rt.sunSouthTilt.tooltip: How far south the noon sun sits. 0° is straight overhead; more gives longer midday shadows.
caustica.options.rt.nameTags.tooltip: Shows names above players and mobs.
caustica.options.rt.blockOutline.tooltip: Outlines the block you are looking at.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaveStrength.to: Wave height. 0x flattens the water; up to 4x makes stormy seas.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaveDetail.tool: Amount of small wave detail. Lower is faster on large oceans.
caustica.options.rt.parallaxQuality.tool: Higher keeps fine relief sharp at low angles but costs more; lower is faster.
caustica.options.rt.cloudCoverage.toolti: How much of the sky is cloudy in clear weather. Rain adds more.
caustica.options.rt.cloudCoverage.classi: Classic clouds have fixed coverage. Switch to Volumetric to use this slider.
caustica.options.rt.fog.tooltip: Fog lit by real light: sun shafts, moonlight and torch glow, blocked by walls.
caustica.options.rt.fogDensity.tooltip: How thick the fog is. 0% is no fog.
caustica.options.rt.fogDistance.tooltip: How far the fog reaches. Shorter keeps nearby light shafts strong without hiding the horizon.
caustica.options.rt.fogAnisotropy.toolti: Higher makes fog glow toward the light, for stronger sun shafts; 0 glows evenly.
caustica.options.rt.fogBiomeTint.tooltip: How much fog takes on the biome's colour, like green in swamps and grey in storms.
caustica.options.rt.fogHeightFalloff.too: Off: fog everywhere. Any value turns it into valley mist that thins higher up.
caustica.options.rt.risCandidates.toolti: Light sources tested per pixel. Higher helps scenes with many torches but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.minFillRatio.tooltip: Skips very small light sources. Higher is faster but can lose tiny lights.
caustica.options.rt.restirHistory.toolti: More reduces light flicker but can smear moving lights; less reacts faster.
caustica.options.rt.restirSpatial.toolti: More smooths light flicker but costs more; 0 turns it off.
caustica.options.rt.restirMaxAge.tooltip: Longer means less flicker; shorter reacts faster to lighting changes.
caustica.options.rt.exposureKey.tooltip: The overall brightness auto exposure aims for. Lower is darker, higher is brighter.
caustica.options.rt.exposureMinEv.toolti: Dark limit for auto exposure, so nights stay dark.
caustica.options.rt.exposureMaxEv.toolti: Bright limit for auto exposure, so the sun does not wash out the image.
caustica.options.rt.adaptUp.tooltip: How fast your eyes adjust to the dark, like when entering a cave.
caustica.options.rt.adaptDown.tooltip: How fast your eyes adjust to bright light.
caustica.options.rt.reflexBoost.tooltip: Keeps the GPU clocks up for slightly lower latency. Uses more power.
caustica.options.rt.reflexMinInterval.to: Frame rate cap in microseconds per frame (16667 = 60 FPS). 0 means no cap.
caustica.options.rt.asyncDispatch.toolti: Terrain sections sent to be built at a time. Higher loads faster; lower is smoother on weak CPUs.
caustica.options.rt.resultsPerPass.toolt: Finished terrain sections added at a time. Higher fills in faster; lower avoids stutters.
caustica.options.rt.maxInflight.tooltip: Terrain sections built at once. Raise it if terrain lags behind when flying fast.
caustica.options.rt.blasCompaction.toolt: Halves terrain video memory for slightly slower builds. Changing it rebuilds the terrain.
caustica.options.rt.ommSubdivision.toolt: Higher fits leaf and grass edges more precisely but costs more. Changing it rebuilds the terrain.
caustica.options.rt.pauseWhenUnfocused.t: Stops rendering while the game window is in the background. Turn it off if you record or stream.
caustica.options.rt.frameStats.tooltip: Logs frame timings and stutters to the console. For debugging.
caustica.options.rt.ommStats.tooltip: Log opacity-micromap build statistics to the console. Debug information only.
caustica.options.rt.lightStats.tooltip: Logs light source statistics to the console. For debugging.
caustica.options.rt.lightDump.tooltip: Lists nearby lights in the console on every update. Very noisy; for debugging.
caustica.options.rt.lightDumpRadius.tool: Radius in blocks around the camera for the Light Dump emitter listing.
caustica.options.rt.fgEngine.tooltip: Caustica Native works on any GPU and goes up to 4x. AMD FSR 3.1 is fixed at 2x.
caustica.options.rt.bloom.tooltip: Adds a glow around bright lights and highlights.
caustica.options.rt.bloomQuality.tooltip: Higher gives a smoother, wider glow but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.bloomIntensity.toolt: Strength of the glow. 0% turns it off.
caustica.options.rt.bloomThreshold.toolt: How bright something must be to glow. Lower makes more things glow.
caustica.options.rt.bloomSoftKnee.toolti: Softens the edge between glowing and non-glowing areas.
caustica.options.rt.bloomRadius.tooltip: Size of the glow. Lower is tight; higher spreads wide.
0% gives a white glow; 100% keeps each light's colour; higher makes it richer.
caustica.options.rt.dof.tooltip: Blurs what is in front of and behind the focus, like a camera lens.
caustica.options.rt.dofFocusMode.tooltip: Manual uses Focal Distance; Auto focuses on the centre of the screen.
caustica.options.rt.dofFocalDistance.too: Distance in focus, in blocks (Manual only).
caustica.options.rt.dofAperture.tooltip: Lower numbers blur more; higher numbers keep more in focus.
caustica.options.rt.dofMaxBlur.tooltip: Limits how strong the blur can get.
caustica.options.rt.wetnessEnabled.toolt: Ground turns dark and shiny in the rain, then dries. Ground under roofs stays dry.
caustica.options.rt.wetnessWetSeconds.to: Seconds for ground wetness to rise from dry to fully wet while rain continues.
caustica.options.rt.wetnessDrySeconds.to: Seconds for fully wet ground to return to dry after the rain ends.
caustica.options.rt.wetnessTransitionDis: How softly wetness fades out under roofs, in blocks.
caustica.options.rt.groundRainRipples.to: Draws small rain ripples on wet ground.
caustica.options.rt.waterRainRipples.too: Draws rain rings on open water.
caustica.options.rt.waterRippleScale.too: Size of rain rings on water.
Strength of rain rings on water.
caustica.options.rt.rainRefractionEnable: Rain streaks bend the view behind them like drops of water.
caustica.options.rt.rainRefractionStreng: How strongly rain bends the view.
caustica.options.rt.underwaterHazeEnable: Adds haze while you are underwater.
caustica.options.rt.underwaterHazeStreng: How thick underwater haze is. Higher shortens the view.
caustica.options.rt.underwaterSkyEnabled: Fixes black patches on the horizon while underwater.
caustica.options.rt.underwaterSkyDistanc: How far underwater views reach when they never meet the surface, in blocks.
caustica.options.rt.rainCloudResponse.to: Rain makes clouds thicker and darker.
caustica.options.rt.rainCloudDensity.too: How thick and dark rain clouds get.
caustica.options.rt.lightningEnabled.too: Random lightning in rain that lights up the sky and ground.
caustica.options.rt.lightningStrikesPerM: Average lightning strikes per minute in rain.
caustica.options.perfTest.needWorld: Caustica: join a world with ray tracing on before running the performance test.
caustica.options.perfTest.started: Caustica performance test started: %1$s steps, about %2$s s at 20 FPS. Stand still, do not open menus, and press the key again to cancel.
caustica.options.perfTest.cancelled: Caustica performance test cancelled; your settings are restored.
caustica.options.perfTest.done: Caustica performance test done; settings restored. Report: rt-frame-stats/%s
caustica.options.perfTest.doneLog: Caustica performance test done; settings restored. The report is in latest.log.
